subject: add_to_index
prompt: Trace how a document uploaded through the API (documents.views.PostDocumentView.post) ends up written to the full-text search index once it has been consumed. The path crosses a Celery task, the consume plugins and a Django signal. List every function or method on that path, including both ends, where each one calls, queues or signals the next; end at the search-index batch method that writes the document, and leave out helpers that only return an object, such as get_backend. Name them as dotted paths from src/.
